title: Ants vs Termites RTS - Mobile
author: Neat_Dig2710
selftext:
Early work but foundations are set. Large scale termite vs ant RTS. Build a colony starting with a queen and founding chamber, expand the nest, secure resources, build an army, defend you're queen and kill there's.

Currently upto 4 players/AI.

You will manage a proper brood life cycle. You can also dig to the enemy nest so underground combat is a thing. I'm in the process of improving the animation pipeline which im soon to integrate and will have brutal finishing moves and look less wooden.

This video is a battle test (Very WIP) Actively working on target acquisition, pathfinding which is effective and low cost for CPU usage. Landscape is WIP. Going well so far. It's taken a lot longer than it looks.... 😂
